title: GTA 6 Locked at 30fps on PS5: A Dealbreaker for Players?
description: Rockstar Games has confirmed GTA 6 will target 30fps on PS5 and PS5 Pro, sparking debate among fans hoping for a 60fps experience.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Framerate Confirmed: The 30fps PS5 Reality

Your potential nightmare has officially become a reality: Grand Theft Auto VI runs at just 30 frames-per-second on both the PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 5 Pro. The target frame rate was confirmed earlier today by Rockstar Games itself, prompting an outpouring of relative disappointment from those who were banking on a silky 60fps experience.

### The Community Reaction to the Framerate Limit

As one of the most anticipated releases in gaming history, expectations for technical performance have always been sky-high. With the arrival of the PS5 Pro, a segment of the gaming community naturally anticipated that Rockstar would unlock the potential for a 60fps performance mode. However, today's confirmation from the developer has dashed those hopes for console players prioritizing ultra-smooth motion over maximum graphical fidelity.

### Balancing Act of Open-World Scale and Performance

Developing a massive, highly detailed open-world sandbox comes with immense technical hurdles. The sheer density, complex AI, and cutting-edge visual effects packed into GTA 6 demand heavy computational power. Opting for a 30fps target suggests that Rockstar is prioritizing visual richness, world simulation, and cinematic presentation over higher framerates on standard and enhanced current-gen hardware. While some players consider frame rate to be a non-negotiable standard in modern gaming, others remain willing to accept the compromise for the sake of the ultimate sandbox experience.

### Editor's Take

While a 30fps cap on current-gen hardware is undeniably disappointing for high-framerate enthusiasts, it's a testament to the sheer scale and ambition of GTA 6. Rockstar's titles have historically prioritized immersive detail and environmental fidelity, and if a locked 30fps ensures a stable, visually stunning masterpiece, most players will likely adapt once they step foot into the game's vibrant world.
